scientific_review.important: Library completeness does not activate BASIC recommendations. BASIC eligibility still requires scientific deep record + deterministic rule + safety review.
scientific_review.review_queue_policy: Entries requiring deeper source-specific review remain educational; do not imply clinically validated recommendations.

commercial_future: Brand, SKU, price and availability stay outside the scientific Library and can later map to canonical component IDs.

recommendation_render_requirements.how_to_take: Evidence-based administration guidance; if no established timing, explicitly state uncertainty.
recommendation_render_requirements.daily_amount_guidance: Evidence-based units and conditional everyday equivalence; no invented tablet strengths, household microdoses or personalized prescription.
recommendation_render_requirements.library_safety_cta: Direct canonical ingredient record navigation with interactions, contraindications, adverse effects, precautions and sources.
recommendation_render_requirements.no_source_or_unverified_safety: Do not activate a positive recommendation solely because the library entry exists.
